items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Shorty had just gone with Will Bradley. That was his first band. So I called him...

ctx.x: Sure. A Pullman type? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Yeah. And they’d disconnect us and connect us with another train and all that. So we did a whole bunch of theaters. Mildred did some of them with us. But Jimmy Durante was part of the act, until the draft started getting through to the band. So then Red broke up and wanted to get a small band. So he said I don’t have any trumpet player that knows how to play small band, you know in the big band it was different. So I said yeah, I know a guy. And when I was a kid, I played with a band called Hal Gill, who was from…
